title: N7 effective-basis trio_matches_row is unpinned — no test distinguishes it from the r3 snapshot basis (the exact scenario the fix targets)
evidence: No test calls do_correct and do_substitute in one flow (awk over the integration file: zero overlap); corrected_name is asserted only at :414 (correct_requeues test). substitute_history_row_with_different_trio_is_conflict_test re-submits on an UNCORRECTED successor where snapshot == effective, so both bases answer 409.
detail: The N7 scenario: successor corrected (corrected_name != contact_name), landlord re-submits the old history row with the successor's SNAPSHOT trio. Effective basis -> 409; the old snapshot basis -> 200 no-op silently dropping the typed referee. A regression back to the r3 basis ships green.
recommended_fix: Integration test: substitute -> do_correct on the successor -> re-submit the history row with the pre-correction trio -> expect 409 AlreadyReplaced + still one audit; a snapshot-basis implementation fails this.

title: N10 vacancy-check Error arm (and the wrong-person exhaust Error arm) have no test — only the archived-422 arm is pinned
evidence: row_actions_authz_negatives_test pins the archived-vacancy 422 arm and the outsider 404; no test drives verify_vacancy_active into Error. form_handler.gleam exhaust_wrong_person's Error arm ("reference wrong-person exhaustion: terminal failed" -> ReferenceWrongPersonExhaustFailed capture) is likewise unreached.
detail: Both r4 Error-arm fixes are code-verified but fault-injection-only paths: a regression that silently fell through to action() on an unverifiable vacancy (N10) or swallowed an exhaust failure would pass CI. Same class as N11 (c4) and the do_take_over Error arm.
recommended_fix: Accept as untestable-without-fault-injection and document, or add a test seam (e.g. a poisoned-connection helper) that asserts 500 + no mutation for the vacancy-check Error arm.
